entry.summary:
We’re so excited to Get To Know @theyloveemerson week with Charlotte Ryan!

In this episode, Emerson dives into the story behind her name, her early days in the spotlight through theatre and dance, and how she unexpectedly discovered singing as her true lane. She opens up about her dreams, her drive, and what’s on the horizon for her next.
